Transaction Lineup Value Drill-In | Click to inspect team, player, and week totals

How to read this evidence: This view keeps both sides of the transaction story. Added Lineup Value shows what pickups contributed to the best plausible lineup. Moved-Away Follow-Up shows value produced after players moved away, which is context rather than automatic blame. Open a team, then a week, to compare the actual lineup against the transaction-model ideal lineup.

Move Timing vs Week Impact: A week can show transaction value even when no move happened that week. The lineup impact carries forward after a player is added or dropped, so the weekly totals show ongoing effect while the move table only shows transactions executed in that specific week.
